matched.set_a_axis: Agency-Communion Integration: From Deferential Communion to Agentic Communion
matched.set_b_axis: Agency-Communion Balance: From Deferential Hearth-Service to Assertive Communion
matched.overlap_description: Both identify the same core movement: Hestia begins communion-dominant and deferential (obedient service to Zeus and traditional domestic order, little self-assertion) and ends with agency integrated into communion (she asserts a reinterpreted hearth while remaining relational). Sets differ only in emphasis and confidence (A 'high', B 'medium') and in trajectory granularity (A gives three phases, B two).

matched.set_a_axis: Hearth Ideology: From Fixed Domestic Confinement to Renegotiated Shared Hearth
matched.set_b_axis: Hearth Purpose Reinterpretation: From Domestic Confinement to Shared Sanctuary
matched.overlap_description: Direct conceptual identity: Hestia's belief about what the hearth means shifts from a fixed traditional order requiring enforcement (guiding women back home) to a renegotiated relational order of shared burdens, belonging, and heard voices. Both cite the same evidence chain (decree, protest, Phebe's testimony on bias and invisible labor, final silent reinterpretation).

matched.set_a_axis: Self-Concept Revision: From Tradition's Guardian to Independent Moral Interpreter
matched.set_b_axis: Obedience to Conscience: From Unquestioning Divine Obedience to Loyal Quiet Defiance
matched.overlap_description: Partial but substantive match. Both track the same interior shift from obedient divine servant to independent moral agent who quietly dissents from forced-confinement implications while remaining loyal in word. A frames it as identity/self-concept (guardian of tradition -> interpreter); B frames it as conscience versus obedience. B adds the important nuance that the divergence is not yet fully confronted, which A underplays.

matched.set_a_axis: Epistemic Stance: From Doctrinal Assumption to Experiential Inquiry
matched.set_b_axis: Epistemic Humility: From Top-Down Certainty to Receptive Learning
matched.overlap_description: Same axis: Hestia begins interpreting the modern world from inherited doctrinal assumption and divine certainty, and ends privileging direct listening, testimony, and first-hand observation. Both cite the protest, Phebe's concrete stories, and the request to observe a modern household as the turning evidence; confidence is complementary (A medium, B high).

matched.set_a_axis: Zeus — From Unquestioning Loyalty to Loyal Dissent
matched.set_b_axis: Zeus — From Respectful Compliance to Loyal Quiet Defiance
matched.overlap_description: Same dyad and same shape: deferential acceptance of Zeus's decree, followed by supernatural coercive pressure (drafts, tremors, darkness, thunder), followed by silent internal resistance that preserves verbal loyalty. A stresses the strain on trust; B stresses that trust and esteem remain high while the attitude becomes conflicted.

matched.set_a_axis: Phebe — From Sharp Challenge to Trusted Alliance
matched.set_b_axis: Phebe — From Wary Observation to Warming Respect
matched.overlap_description: Same dyad and same directional warming. Sets differ on the starting pole: A foregrounds Phebe's sharp public confrontation (low trust, antagonism), B foregrounds Hestia's cautious, wary observation of an unfamiliar modern guide. These are compatible descriptions of the same first encounter and should be merged as wary distance plus candid challenge leading to trust and respect.

intrapersonal_axes.axis_name: From Deferential Service to Agentic Communion
intrapersonal_axes.pole_start: Hestia begins communion-dominant and deferential: her communion is expressed through obedience to Zeus, selfless devotion to the hearth, and acceptance of an unfamiliar mission without asserting her own interpretation, with little self-assertion.
intrapersonal_axes.pole_end: Hestia ends as an agentic but still relational moral actor: she quietly asserts her own reinterpretation of the mission while remaining committed to a hearth defined by shared burdens and heard voices.

trajectory.position_description: High communion through loyalty and service, low agency: Hestia accepts Zeus's decree with calm deference and private uncertainty rather than questioning or redefining it.
key_moments: Zeus summons Hestia and decrees that she must travel to the present world to restore order by guiding women back to hearth and home.
Hestia accepts the decree with deference and reaffirms her loyalty.
Hestia passes through Zeus's portal and is overwhelmed and quietly disoriented by the modern city, yet remains resolute in divine duty.

trajectory.position_description: Communion expands through listening and empathy while a nascent agency appears in curiosity and in her request to observe a modern household.
key_moments: Hestia observes a women's protest demanding equal pay and a banner declaring women's power lies in their united voice.
Hestia questions a protestor and is sharply challenged by Phebe, becoming aware that her traditional views may seem outdated or confining.
Phebe recounts workplace bias against a mother and the invisible second shift endured by Maya, deepening Hestia's understanding.

trajectory.position_description: Hestia moves toward agentic communion: she silently asserts an independent moral interpretation, redefining the mission as building a hearth of shared burdens and heard voices rather than enforcing confinement.
key_moments: Hestia asks to observe a modern household firsthand.
Under Zeus's supernatural pressure (drafts, tremors, darkness, thunder), Hestia resolutely and quietly defies the implied coercion by reinterpreting her sacred purpose.

intrapersonal_axes.evidence_summary: Both analyses converge: Hestia starts in obedient, communion-dominant service to Zeus and ends by asserting her own moral interpretation while retaining a relational, hearth-centered ethic. The change integrates agency with communion rather than trading one for the other.

intrapersonal_axes.axis_name: From Fixed Domestic Confinement to Renegotiated Shared Hearth
intrapersonal_axes.pole_start: Hestia initially accepts Zeus's framing that restoring order means guiding women back to hearth and home, treating traditional domestic roles as the proper source of harmony and women's external pursuits as potential distraction.
intrapersonal_axes.pole_end: Hestia redefines the hearth as a sanctuary of shared burdens, heard voices, belonging, and renegotiated duties rather than enforced confinement or unexamined self-sacrifice.

trajectory.position_description: Hestia receives Zeus's decree without disputing its premise that women should be guided back to hearth and home, framing her task as correcting women's external pursuits.
key_moments: Zeus decrees that Hestia must restore order by guiding women back to hearth and home.
Hestia intends to guide women back to domestic order out of loyalty to Zeus's authority.

trajectory.position_description: The protest and Phebe's confrontation challenge Hestia's assumption that women's power outside the home necessarily threatens household harmony.
key_moments: Hestia observes the protest's demands for equal pay and its banner about women's united voice.
Phebe sharply confronts Hestia over the assumption that a woman's strength belongs only in the kitchen.
Hestia begins to question whether women's focus outside the home necessarily threatens household harmony.

trajectory.position_description: Hestia recognizes that 'chains' include invisible domestic labor and structural penalties, and shifts to a hearth model grounded in shared responsibility, belonging, and justice.
key_moments: Phebe explains workplace bias against a mother and the invisible second shift endured by Maya.
Phebe explains 'quiet rebellion' and shared responsibility in the home.
Hestia silently asserts to Zeus a mission to build a hearth of shared burdens and heard voices rather than enforce outdated confinement.

intrapersonal_axes.evidence_summary: Both sources agree this is the chapter's most explicit tracked shift: Hestia's conception of the hearth moves from fixed traditional order requiring enforcement to a renegotiated relational order built on shared responsibility and voice. Set B's 'shared sanctuary' language and Set A's 'renegotiated duties' language are merged here.

intrapersonal_axes.axis_name: From Tradition's Faithful Guardian to Independent Moral Interpreter
intrapersonal_axes.pole_start: Hestia sees herself as a faithful divine agent and guardian of a fixed tradition, treating Zeus's decree as the highest order and following it even when the path is unclear, while avoiding open divergence.
intrapersonal_axes.pole_end: Hestia sees herself as an independent moral agent who can remain loyal to Zeus while reinterpreting his command, quietly asserting that inclusive shared harmony serves a higher order; the divergence is felt but not yet fully confronted.

trajectory.position_description: Hestia reaffirms herself as a faithful divine agent, loyal and respectful toward Zeus's authority, responding to his ominous disruptions with steady resolve.
key_moments: Hestia accepts Zeus's decree with deference and reaffirms her loyalty.
Hestia meets Zeus's supernatural disruptions (drafts, darkness, thunder) with steady resolve.

trajectory.position_description: Phebe's challenge makes Hestia aware that her traditional self-presentation may be perceived as outdated or confining, turning certainty into curiosity and concern.
key_moments: Phebe confronts Hestia over her apparent assumption that a woman's strength belongs only in the kitchen.
Hestia becomes increasingly uneasy with the forced-confinement implications of Zeus's decree.

trajectory.position_description: Hestia becomes a learner and independent interpreter who can dissent inwardly from divine coercion, while still intending loyalty and not yet fully confronting the depth of her divergence.
key_moments: Hestia asks to observe a modern household firsthand as a self-directed act of inquiry.
Hestia quietly asserts to Zeus that inclusive shared harmony serves the highest order.
Hestia resolutely reinterprets Zeus's mission while under supernatural pressure.

intrapersonal_axes.evidence_summary: Merges Set A's 'self-concept revision' with Set B's 'obedience to conscience' and its caveat. Hestia's self-perception shifts from obedient guardian of fixed tradition to independent moral interpreter who integrates loyalty with critical judgment; the resistance is quiet and internal rather than an open break.

intrapersonal_axes.axis_name: From Doctrinal Certainty to Experiential Inquiry
intrapersonal_axes.pole_start: Hestia begins from inherited doctrinal assumptions and divine certainty about hearth, home, and the women she must guide, interpreting the modern world from the distance of tradition and observation alone.
intrapersonal_axes.pole_end: Hestia ends by privileging epistemic humility, direct listening, first-hand observation, and lived testimony as necessary for understanding how to restore harmony.

trajectory.position_description: Hestia observes the modern city and protest with curiosity and confusion, resolute in duty but quietly disoriented, still interpreting through her prior framework.
key_moments: Hestia is overwhelmed by the modern city.
Hestia observes the women's protest and hears demands that challenge her assumptions.

trajectory.position_description: Hestia questions a protestor and is confronted by Phebe, learning through direct encounter rather than judgment from afar.
key_moments: Hestia questions a protestor and is sharply challenged by Phebe.
Initial certainty gives way to curiosity and concern.

trajectory.position_description: Hestia listens to concrete testimony and seeks access to a modern household, treating lived experience as a source of moral knowledge and acknowledging she knows little of this world.
key_moments: Phebe recounts workplace bias and invisible domestic labor.
Hestia recognizes that true understanding requires listening rather than merely watching.
Hestia asks to observe a modern household firsthand.

intrapersonal_axes.evidence_summary: Both sets identify the same epistemic movement from doctrinal assumption and top-down certainty to receptive learning. Set A calls it 'experiential inquiry', Set B 'epistemic humility'; the merged axis keeps both halves: humbled about what she knows, and committed to listening and observing as the method.

relational_axes.axis_name: From Deferential Compliance to Loyal Quiet Defiance
relational_axes.pole_start: Hestia relates to Zeus with deferential trust, respect, and obedience, accepting his decree as binding without visible resistance.
relational_axes.pole_end: Hestia remains loyal and respectful in word, with trust and esteem still high, but she is conflicted and quietly resists the coercive implications of the decree by reinterpreting it, introducing strain into the relationship.

trajectory.position_description: Hestia accepts Zeus's decree with calm deference, high trust and esteem, and reaffirms her loyalty to his authority without open challenge.
key_moments: Zeus summons Hestia and decrees her mission to guide women back to hearth and home.
Hestia accepts the decree with deference and remains loyal and respectful.

trajectory.position_description: Zeus's supernatural pressure makes the relationship feel coercive as Hestia begins to form a reinterpreted mission.
key_moments: Drafts, tremors, darkness, and thunder manifest as Hestia considers her reinterpreted mission.
Hestia responds to the ominous disruptions with steady resolve rather than submission or open rebellion.

trajectory.position_description: Hestia silently asserts a reinterpreted mission, loyal in word but resistant in spirit, quietly insisting that inclusive shared harmony serves the highest order.
key_moments: Hestia silently asserts to Zeus a mission to build a hearth of shared burdens and heard voices rather than enforce outdated confinement.
Hestia does not yet fully confront the depth of her divergence from Zeus.

relational_axes.evidence_summary: Merged from both sets: the Zeus relationship moves from uncomplicated deference to ambivalent but loyal dissent. Set A stresses the resulting strain on trust; Set B stresses that trust and esteem stay high and the conflict is internal and not yet openly confronted.

relational_axes.axis_name: From Wary Confrontation to Trusted Guide
relational_axes.pole_start: Hestia meets Phebe with wary distance and low initial trust, experiencing her as an unfamiliar modern challenger and public accuser of her traditional assumptions.
relational_axes.pole_end: Hestia trusts and esteems Phebe as a candid guide and ally whose testimony reshapes her understanding of the hearth, warming to her perspective on the modern world.

trajectory.position_description: Hestia observes Phebe and the protestors with cautious distance; Phebe's sharp challenge provokes surprise and curiosity rather than retreat.
key_moments: Hestia listens to Phebe and the protestors with wary observation and growing curiosity.
Phebe sharply confronts Hestia over her apparent assumption that a woman's strength belongs only in the kitchen.

trajectory.position_description: Phebe's concrete stories earn Hestia's respect, and the conversation deepens mutual understanding.
key_moments: Phebe recounts workplace bias against a mother and the invisible second shift endured by Maya.
Phebe explains 'quiet rebellion' and shared responsibility in the home.
Hestia comes to see Phebe as a candid guide who illuminates the modern world.

trajectory.position_description: Hestia trusts Phebe enough to seek access to a modern household through her and makes her reinterpreted stand in Phebe's presence.
key_moments: Hestia asks to observe a modern household firsthand.
Hestia silently asserts her reinterpreted mission while with Phebe.

relational_axes.evidence_summary: Both sets agree the Hestia-Phebe relationship warms substantially and Phebe becomes the key interlocutor for Hestia's revised hearth ethic. Set A's 'sharp challenge to trusted alliance' and Set B's 'wary observation to warming respect' describe the same dyad from two angles and are combined into one three-phase arc.

matched.set_a_axis: From Confrontational Agency to Dialogic Communion
matched.set_b_axis: From confrontational self-assertion to dialogic relational openness
matched.overlap_description: Both describe the same core movement within Chapter 1: Phebe begins as a public, bullhorn-wielding protest leader who confronts Hestia in front of the crowd, and ends in a private café conversation that is softer, thoughtful, and dialogic while retaining her principled insistence on systemic change.

matched.set_a_axis: From Defensive Certainty to Nuanced Openness
matched.set_b_axis: From dismissing hearth devotion as confinement to respecting chosen devotion
matched.overlap_description: Both trace Phebe's reinterpretation of Hestia's hearth commitment: an initial reading of it as regressive confinement / an 'outdated notion' to be corrected, giving way to a distinction between chosen devotion and coerced confinement, with respect for Hestia's sincerity alongside a preserved critique of structural inequality.

unique_to_a.axis: From Defensive Reactivity to Empathetic Receptivity (Emotional Receptivity)

matched.set_a_axis: From Adversarial Distrust to Respectful Trust
matched.set_b_axis: From wary confrontation to respectful, curious dialogue
matched.overlap_description: Both capture the same dyadic shift toward Hestia: initial public antagonism and wariness framing her as an adversary of women's public strength, moving to respectful, curious, thoughtful engagement in private conversation. Set B labels the endpoint 'respectful curiosity' rather than 'trust,' and explicitly notes intimacy remains low.

unique_to_a.axis: From Guarded Public Opposition to Personal Intimacy (Distance to Intimacy)

intrapersonal_axes.axis_name: From Confrontational Self-Assertion to Dialogic Communion
intrapersonal_axes.pole_start: Self-assertive and confrontational: Phebe acts as an impassioned public protest leader, uses a bullhorn, treats Hestia as a representative of 'outdated' confinement, and asserts her convictions through public challenge.
intrapersonal_axes.pole_end: Relational and dialogic without losing agency: Phebe lowers the bullhorn, invites private conversation, listens respectfully, honors Hestia's chosen commitment, and shares personal vulnerability while still pressing firmly for systemic change.

trajectory.position_description: Strongly agency-poled: Phebe overhears Hestia question whether a woman's strength can be drawn from outside the hearth and sharply confronts her before the protest crowd, framing her as an adversary of women's public voice.
key_moments: Begins as an impassioned protest leader with a bullhorn
Challenges Hestia publicly with conviction
Treats Hestia initially as an 'outdated' voice of confinement

trajectory.position_description: Moving toward communion: Phebe explains her cause passionately and shifts from public confrontation to inviting Hestia into a quieter café dialogue, though she remains guarded.
key_moments: After Hestia asks sincere questions about the 'chains' and the 'home where voices matter,' Phebe explains her cause
Phebe lowers her bullhorn and invites Hestia to a café conversation

trajectory.position_description: Firmly in communion: Phebe listens to Hestia's account of the hearth as a chosen path of strength and responds with respect, while still explaining other women's need for choice and fair treatment.
key_moments: Phebe honors Hestia's chosen devotion while distinguishing it from coerced confinement
She articulates the 'chains' as both invisible expectations and structural penalties

trajectory.position_description: Deepens communion through trust and personal disclosure, retaining passion about injustice expressed through dialogue rather than confrontation.
key_moments: Phebe shares specific stories of workplace bias, unequal domestic labor, and quiet rebellion
She stays candid and empathetic while continuing to press for systemic change

intrapersonal_axes.evidence_summary: Both analyses independently describe Phebe's movement from public, confrontational assertion to private, thoughtful, dialogic engagement — softening and listening without abandoning her principles.

intrapersonal_axes.axis_name: From Dismissing Hearth Devotion as Confinement to Respecting Chosen Devotion
intrapersonal_axes.pole_start: Phebe holds a binary conviction: questions about the hearth reinforce outdated confinement, and Hestia is a 'maiden' defending the very expectations Phebe fights, to be challenged and educated.
intrapersonal_axes.pole_end: Phebe distinguishes chosen devotion from coerced confinement, honoring Hestia's sincerity, strength, and independence, while preserving her critique of invisible expectations and structural penalties.

trajectory.position_description: Phebe interprets Hestia's question as regressive and responds defensively, seeing her as an adversary clinging to outdated ideas.
key_moments: Phebe sharply confronts Hestia over the overheard question about strength from outside the hearth
She challenges 'outdated notions' publicly

trajectory.position_description: Phebe begins to consider that Hestia's questions may come from genuine seeking rather than judgment, and grants her a fuller hearing.
key_moments: Hestia asks sincere questions about the 'chains' and the 'home where voices matter'
Phebe explains her cause at length and invites further conversation

trajectory.position_description: Phebe's view of the hearth becomes genuinely more nuanced: chosen devotion is honored, oppression is still named, and the two are no longer conflated.
key_moments: Phebe honors Hestia's commitment to the hearth while explaining women's fights for choice and fair treatment
She reframes 'chains' as both invisible expectations and structural penalties

trajectory.position_description: Phebe retains her critique of systemic barriers while accepting that not every commitment to home is oppression; she treats Hestia as strong rather than deluded.
key_moments: Phebe shares stories of workplace bias, unequal domestic labor, and quiet rebellion
She maintains firm but respectful persuasive dialogue without reverting to a binary view

intrapersonal_axes.evidence_summary: Both sets identify a real but contained reappraisal: Phebe revises her read of Hestia from a defender of confinement to a sincere practitioner of chosen devotion, without surrendering her feminist critique of structural inequality.

intrapersonal_axes.axis_name: From Defensive Reactivity to Empathetic, Candid Receptivity
intrapersonal_axes.pole_start: Phebe is defensive, indignant, and quick to confront; she listens through the lens of protecting women's public voice against regressive ideas.
intrapersonal_axes.pole_end: Phebe is thoughtful, respectful, empathetic, candid, and invested; frustration at injustice persists but is channeled through listening, sharing, and dialogue.

trajectory.position_description: Phebe reacts sharply and indignantly to Hestia's question, interpreting it as reinforcement of outdated confinement.
key_moments: Phebe sharply confronts Hestia in front of the protest crowd

trajectory.position_description: Phebe remains guarded but becomes softer and curious when Hestia asks sincere questions rather than attacking.
key_moments: Phebe passionately explains her cause, lowers her bullhorn, and invites Hestia to a café conversation

trajectory.position_description: Phebe listens thoughtfully and responds with respect and empathy to Hestia's chosen path.
key_moments: Phebe honors Hestia's commitment to the hearth while explaining women's need for choice and fair treatment

trajectory.position_description: Phebe is candid and vulnerable, sharing frustration and personal experience in a way that deepens trust.
key_moments: Phebe shares specific stories of workplace bias, unequal domestic labor, and quiet rebellion

intrapersonal_axes.evidence_summary: Only the event-graph analysis formalized this as a distinct axis, but it captures a dimension both accounts describe informally: Phebe's emotional register shifts from defensive indignation to empathetic, candid dialogue, with her anger at injustice redirected rather than extinguished.

relational_axes.axis_name: From Adversarial Distrust to Respectful, Curious Trust
relational_axes.pole_start: Phebe views Hestia as an adversary clinging to outdated ideas and as a defender of confinement; antagonism is high, curiosity low, and trust minimal.
relational_axes.pole_end: Phebe treats Hestia as a sincere interlocutor whose chosen devotion deserves respect; antagonism is reduced and respectful curiosity — and, in the event-graph reading, a measure of trust and esteem — has grown, though the relationship remains low in intimacy.

trajectory.position_description: Phebe frames Hestia as an opponent aligned with confinement and confronts her publicly, warily challenging her as a representative of outdated notions.
key_moments: Phebe overhears Hestia's question about strength and the hearth and sharply confronts her
Phebe views Hestia as a 'maiden' defending confinement

trajectory.position_description: Phebe moves from an adversarial stance to cautious openness, granting Hestia a private hearing and explaining her cause in more detail.
key_moments: Phebe explains her cause and invites Hestia to a quieter café conversation
Phebe lowers her bullhorn and lets Hestia speak

trajectory.position_description: Phebe recognizes Hestia's sincerity and chosen devotion; antagonism drops and respectful, thoughtful curiosity takes its place even as Phebe keeps persuading.
key_moments: Phebe honors Hestia's commitment to the hearth while explaining women's need for choice and fair treatment
Phebe maintains firm but respectful dialogic persuasion

trajectory.position_description: Phebe's trust and esteem deepen as she shares personal narratives, treating Hestia as someone worth confiding in.
key_moments: Phebe shares stories of workplace bias, unequal domestic labor, and quiet rebellion

relational_axes.evidence_summary: Both analyses agree the Phebe–Hestia dyad warms from public antagonism to respectful, thoughtful dialogue; Set A additionally calls the endpoint 'trust,' while Set B more conservatively calls it 'respectful curiosity' — the merged reading keeps respect as the confident core and trust as the suggested deepening.

relational_axes.axis_name: From Guarded Public Opposition to Personal Intimacy
relational_axes.pole_start: Phebe keeps Hestia at a guarded public distance, addressing her as a representative of opposing ideas rather than as a person.
relational_axes.pole_end: Phebe engages Hestia personally and vulnerably, sharing specific personal stories and building interpersonal closeness.

trajectory.position_description: Phebe addresses Hestia through public confrontation before a crowd, maintaining emotional and relational distance.
key_moments: Phebe sharply confronts Hestia in front of the protest crowd

trajectory.position_description: Phebe reduces distance by relocating the exchange to a café and listening to Hestia's own account.
key_moments: Phebe lowers her bullhorn and invites Hestia to a quieter café conversation

trajectory.position_description: Phebe engages Hestia's personal commitment with respect, increasing interpersonal closeness.
key_moments: Phebe honors Hestia's description of the hearth as a chosen path of strength

trajectory.position_description: Phebe reveals personal vulnerability and trust, deepening intimacy beyond the political exchange.
key_moments: Phebe shares specific stories of workplace bias, unequal domestic labor, and quiet rebellion

relational_axes.evidence_summary: Only the event-graph analysis isolates the distance–intimacy dimension, but the psychological summary corroborates the underlying movement (public challenge to private café dialogue) while judging the resulting intimacy still low — hence medium confidence and a modest, not dramatic, claimed shift.

matched.set_a_axis: From absolute agency to agency under contestation (without communion shift)
matched.set_b_axis: From dominant agency to unchanged dominant agency
matched.overlap_description: Both sets identify the same underlying dimension (Agency–Communion) and the same essential finding: Zeus begins at an extreme Agency pole (unilateral decree from his throne, Hestia as instrument) and never crosses toward Communion. The only divergence is magnitude of change: Set A observes a slight destabilization of Zeus's confidence in unthinking compliance ('agency under contestation'), while Set B reads the position as entirely stable ('unchanged dominant agency'). Both agree no genuine internal realignment occurs.

matched.set_a_axis: From delegated trust to wary distrust
matched.set_b_axis: From subordinate instrument to suspected subordinate
matched.overlap_description: Both sets describe the same relational shift toward Hestia: an initial phase of confident, instrumental delegation (Hestia as trusted subordinate executor of Zeus's decree) giving way, after Hestia silently reinterprets the mission, to a cooler phase of displeasure, suspicion, and coercive pressure. Set A frames this in Trust–Antagonism terms; Set B frames it in Trust–Esteem with intimacy noted as low. Directionally identical: trust/esteem decline while formal subordination persists.

intrapersonal_axes.axis_name: Fixed at the Agency pole: from unilateral decree to coercive reassertion, with no movement toward communion
intrapersonal_axes.pole_start: Zeus operates from an extreme Agency pole: he summons Hestia, decrees her purpose unilaterally from his throne, defines order as obedience to his decree, and treats her as a divine instrument dispatched through a golden portal.
intrapersonal_axes.pole_end: Zeus remains Agency-dominant and low-communion: rather than moving toward cooperation or shared authority, he responds to Hestia's silent reinterpretation with intensified intimidation (chilling draft, rumbling, flickering lights, thunder, lightning, earthquake), betraying only a mild destabilization of his assumption of unthinking compliance.

trajectory.position_description: Anchored at the extreme Agency pole: Zeus commands rather than consults, issues his mission from his throne, frames order as divine prerogative, and expects his authority to be mirrored by unquestioning obedience.
key_moments: Zeus summons Hestia and decrees that she travel to the present world to restore natural order by guiding women back to hearth and home.
Zeus opens a golden portal, formally dispatching Hestia as his subordinate agent.
Zeus expects his decree to be executed without revision or reinterpretation.

trajectory.position_description: Still strongly Agency-oriented and low-communion: Zeus escalates divine pressure to enforce compliance, showing no move toward cooperation or relational warmth. Both readings converge that his position is stable; only his confidence in automatic compliance is slightly unsettled.
key_moments: Hestia discusses women's struggles with Phebe and silently redefines the hearth as shared burdens and belonging rather than forced confinement.
Zeus responds with a chilling draft, rumbling, flickering lights, thunder, lightning, and an earthquake.
Zeus appears frustrated that his authority is not being mirrored, yet he neither revises his decree nor moves toward shared authority.

intrapersonal_axes.evidence_summary: Both axis sets agree on dimension and direction: Zeus begins at an extreme Agency pole and stays there, never shifting toward Communion. Set A notes a small destabilization of his assumption of unthinking compliance ('agency under contestation'); Set B reads the position as wholly unchanged ('unchanged dominant agency'). Synthesizing, the most defensible reading is a flat arc with a minor perturbation: intensified coercion substitutes for any internal realignment. Evidence is confined to chapter 1, so confidence is medium rather than high.

relational_axes.axis_name: From delegated trust in a compliant instrument to cooling suspicion and coercive pressure
relational_axes.pole_start: Zeus relates to Hestia through confident, hierarchical trust: she is a subordinate divine instrument with medium trust and esteem, low intimacy, and an expectation that she will execute his decree faithfully and without reinterpretation.
relational_axes.pole_end: Zeus's trust in Hestia's compliance is weakened and his esteem cools; displeasure, suspicion, and antagonistic divine pressure enter the relationship even though Hestia remains formally loyal and Zeus still treats her as his agent.

trajectory.position_description: Zeus relates to Hestia through confident, hierarchical trust: he dispatches her as his instrument and expects obedience to his interpretation of order, with no indication of doubt.
key_moments: Zeus summons Hestia and decrees her mission to restore traditional order by returning women to hearth and home.
Zeus opens a golden portal, establishing Hestia's role as his subordinate agent in the present world.

trajectory.phase: Pressure and silent rebuttal / cooling suspicion
trajectory.position_description: Trust strains as Zeus registers Hestia's independent reinterpretation of the mission; he answers with coercive omens, introducing antagonism and suspicion into a relationship that remains formally hierarchical.
key_moments: Hestia silently asserts loyalty to Zeus's authority while redefining the hearth as shared burdens and belonging rather than forced confinement.
Zeus applies escalating divine pressure through a chilling draft, rumbling, flickering lights, thunder, lightning, and an earthquake.
Zeus appears displeased and suspicious rather than affirming, steering Hestia back toward his original decree.

relational_axes.evidence_summary: Both sets describe the same relational movement in the same direction: from confident instrumental delegation to cooler, more suspicious oversight. Set A emphasizes the emergence of antagonism and diminished trust; Set B emphasizes the drop in trust and esteem with intimacy remaining low. Neither set reports a rupture of loyalty or a shift in formal hierarchy—Hestia stays his agent, and Zeus substitutes intimidation for revised trust. The arc is negative (trust/esteem degrade) and rests entirely on chapter 1 evidence, warranting medium confidence.

matched.set_a_axis: From undetermined to undetermined (no evidenced movement on the Agency–Communion axis)
matched.set_b_axis: From communion-saturated self-effacement toward (unobserved) agency — a position that never moves on the page
matched.overlap_description: Both sets occupy the same named dimension (Bakan's Agency–Communion) as intra_01, but only nominally: Set A declares the axis null because its event list is empty, while Set B actually populates the communion pole from Phebe's secondhand characterization. The dimension matches; the content exists only in B, so the merge inherits B's substance while both agree the axis does not move.

intrapersonal_axes.axis_name: Fixed at communion-saturated self-effacement with no registered agency (unmoving position)
intrapersonal_axes.pole_start: Communion pole: Maya is characterized wholly through what she absorbs for others — full-time employment plus the entirety of cooking, cleaning, and childcare, with a husband who treats his obligations as discharged at the doorstep. Her motivational posture, as reported, is endless accommodation: her needs folded into the household's needs, no boundary-setting, no claim on shared labor.
intrapersonal_axes.pole_end: No ending position is observable. The narrative supplies a single offstage snapshot and no subsequent data, so the axis terminates where it began — communion without registered agency. Any agency-ward movement is latent (private resentment) rather than enacted, and even that is inferred from a third party rather than shown.

trajectory.position_description: Fully at the communion pole with an agency deficit: her labor is described as total and her grievance as private. Because she never appears in a scene and is voiced only through Phebe's advocacy, no movement along the axis can be measured — the position is inferred, not dramatized.
key_moments: Phebe cites Maya as the exemplar of the 'second shift': full-time employment plus sole responsibility for cooking, cleaning, and childcare
Phebe describes a husband who considers his workday finished the moment he crosses the threshold
Phebe frames Maya as exhausted and overburdened, with her labor invisible and unvalued
No scene places Maya in her own household; she exists on the page only as a rhetorical example

intrapersonal_axes.evidence_summary: Set A's contribution for this dimension is an explicit null (empty event list), which carries no textual information and should be read as a schema placeholder rather than a finding. Set B reconstructs the position from Phebe's characterization: maximal communion (self subordinated to family maintenance) paired with an absence of asserted agency. Both sets converge on the same conclusion — no evidenced movement — but only B supplies a defensible starting position. Confidence stays low because the entire characterization is secondhand and single-observation.

intrapersonal_axes.axis_name: From silent endurance toward a possible voiced complaint — an unverified threshold
intrapersonal_axes.pole_start: Silent endurance: the implied state is chronic fatigue and quiet resentment, with her sense of injustice held privately rather than contested inside the household.
intrapersonal_axes.pole_end: Marginal, unverified movement: the sole trace of outward expression is that she has apparently named the imbalance to Phebe — speech to a third party rather than confrontation with her husband. Whether this is the start of a trajectory or merely a pressure valve cannot be determined.

trajectory.position_description: Barely off the starting pole. Disclosure to Phebe is the only evidence that the grievance has been externalized at all, and it is reported rather than dramatized; the axis therefore reads as essentially static.
key_moments: Phebe speaks of Maya with sympathetic familiarity, implying Maya has confided the details of her domestic burden
No scene depicts Maya articulating the grievance directly to her husband or acting on it

intrapersonal_axes.evidence_summary: Retained from Set B as a borderline axis. The private-resentment versus expressed-grievance distinction is the one additional psychologically meaningful dimension the text hints at, and it rests on a single inference (that Maya confided in Phebe). Set A offers no competing or corroborating evidence — its event list is empty — so this axis survives only at low confidence and should be re-evaluated if later chapters return to Maya. It is distinct from final_intra_01 because a character can occupy the communion pole while differing in whether the cost of that position is voiced.

Maya.notes: No relational axes are carried forward. Set A's rel_00 is an explicit placeholder generated from an empty event list (target character unspecified, no starting or ending stance) and is assessed as an artifact with zero informational content. Set B declined to propose any relational axis on principle: Phebe is the only character connected to Maya, the relationship is described at a single moment as already established (sympathetic familiarity, prior confiding), and with no second observation point no shift in trust, esteem, intimacy, or antagonism can be traced. The merged result follows B's reasoning. If later chapters return to Maya, the likeliest genuine relational candidates would be (a) the marital dyad, where the axis of unquestioned division of labor could shift toward negotiated reciprocity, and (b) the Phebe dyad, where mutual recognition could convert into solidarity or open advocacy.

intrapersonal_axes.evidence_summary: Both independent analyses reach the same verdict from complementary evidence gaps: Set A reports an empty event graph, Set B reports a Chapter 1 summary with no Gemini presence. There is consequently no basis for characterizing any intrapersonal arc, and the Agency–Communion axis is retained only to satisfy the mandatory intra_01 slot. Marked low confidence and flat direction; this axis must be re-run once Gemini's chronological events become available.
